description: This file defines the TemplateEnum class, which extends the TemplateText class. It manages enum-type custom fields in SuiteCRM, including their properties, populating from POST data, generating template variables for editing and searching, and fetching field definitions for database schema. It also handles dependencies and visibility grids related to enum fields.

classes.name: TemplateEnum
classes.description: A class representing an enumeration custom field type in SuiteCRM, providing methods for populating field data from POST requests, rendering edit/search templates, retrieving field definitions, and managing dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateEnum object, setting up the localVardefMap and inheriting from the parent class.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the enum field's properties from POST data, including handling dependencies and visibility grids.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates template variables for the edit view of the enum field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Generates template variables for the search view of the enum field.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array used for database schema and form rendering, including options, default values, length, and dependencies.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Generates the display value for the detail view based on the current bean data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Prepares and saves the enum field data, including handling default values and visibility grids.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of the enum field.
